newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian helicopter crashes in Chechnya, eight die.
newsitem.headline: Russian helicopter crashes in Chechnya, eight die.

text.p: Eight people were killed and 24 wounded when a Russian MI-8 military helicopter crashed in Chechnya, and a group of rebel fighters helped take the injured to hospital, Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday.

Interfax news agency said it was not immediately clear why the helicopter, heading for the main Russian military base of Khankala near the regional capital Grozny, crashed and caught fire late on Thursday night.
Interfax, putting the death toll at six, said three passengers and three crew members had been killed.
A peace deal between Russia's security chief Alexander Lebed and the rebel leadership signed in August ended 21 months of bloody fighting in which tens of thousands of people were killed.
